name: TRIBE Bali Kuta Beach
short_description: A 165-room TRIBE lifestyle hotel directly across from Kuta Beach, 20 minutes from the airport, with a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (656 reviews) and a rooftop pool overlooking the beach.
ai_summary: TRIBE Bali Kuta Beach sits directly across the street from Kuta Beach, roughly 20 minutes' drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport and 5 minutes' walk to Beachwalk Shopping Mall. The 165-room property holds a 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 656 reviews. As a TRIBE property it offers contemporary, design-led rooms with a social atmosphere, and guests can enjoy Kuta Beach sunset views from the rooftop restaurant and swimming pool. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: Jalan Pantai Kuta no 99, Kuta, Legian, 80361 Badung, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 165 rooms directly across from Kuta Beach, with a rooftop pool and restaurant overlooking the sunset views
Strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 656 reviews — a substantial, well-established review base
5 minutes' walk to Beachwalk Shopping Mall, 20 minutes from the airport
cons: Kuta Beach is Bali's busiest tourist strip — not suited to travellers wanting a quiet beach experience
TRIBE's social, design-led positioning may feel less formal than a traditional resort for some travellers
research_highlights: Rooftop restaurant and pool with Kuta Beach sunset views
